title: Pull request scope review
scope: Classify repository changes and check whether the PR explanation matches its diff. This is not a security audit or a replacement for tests.

categories.documentation: Changes primarily to documentation and examples
categories.maintenance: Dependency, CI, formatting, or internal maintenance changes

checks.title: Changes match PR explanation
checks.question: Do the supplied PR changes match the purpose described in pullRequest.title and pullRequest.body, without material unrelated changes?
checks.yes: The available diff implements or documents the described purpose without a material unrelated change
checks.no: The actual changes conflict with the explanation or contain material unrelated changes
